features.name: Event mails (check-in)
features.notes: Connecting delivers a hint mail from the game's cast, often pointing to a side event you haven't found yet. There was never an extra scenario to download: the game has no way to receive one, and the mails were always on the cartridge, waiting for a connection. Back then, these mails were most likely what players remembered as new scenarios, since without them most people would have missed those side events.

features.name: World info (market, world events, busiest and quietest battle regions, place names)
features.notes: The world-event schedule is ours, because the original is lost. Your cartridge reports how many random battles you've fought in each region. As in the original, the quietest region pays a quarter more for random battles, and the region where everyone fights most pays half. Since few people play, the bonus starts after a few dozen battles from anyone, but the halving waits until at least three players have connected in the past month. We're still balancing this, and may change it based on how many people play and where they fight. That effect comes from the game's code.
